At least 6 days (one request at a time, with 20 hours of sleep between requests)

Annual event in May: the {npc:Demon Mother}, in the Jakundaf Desert, hands you a baby demon ({item:Demon Infant}) to look after. You have to fulfil 6 random requests from the baby (eating, kissing creatures, visiting places...) and return it happy. You get a baby demon doll, achievements and, if your world returns enough babies, a 50% experience bonus.

A mother's burden becomes a hero's burden when a demon mother decides to take a few days off. Look after and satisfy her horrible little ones to avoid her wrath and earn a reward. Warning: demon babies can be too hot to handle.
Only during the event: **7 to 14 May** (plus 7 days of rewards).
No Premium or minimum level required (level 30 recommended).
You can only look after **one** baby at a time.
one or more (only if the baby asks)
one or more (only if the baby asks)
The requests are random: you don't need to buy everything before you start.
A random demon baby doll: {item:Evilina}, {item:Impward}, {item:Meandi}, {item:Whinona}, {item:Badbara}, {item:Cryana} or {item:Tearesa}
Achievement **I Did My Part** (if you don't have it yet)
Achievement **Nanny from Hell** for completing the event in 5 different years
50% experience bonus until 21 May for the whole world, if at least 500 babies are returned by 14 May
You don't have to start on the first day: you just need to complete 6 requests by the end of the event, so you can skip a few days.
Before fulfilling a request, always use the baby to get its attention. If it starts crying again before you fulfil the request, calm it down by using it again.
Bring a Fishing Rod, a Hammer and some Worms with you: that way you can fulfil those requests right away when they come up.

Travel to the **Jakundaf Desert**, which is **west** of Venore and **south** of Kazordoon: from Venore, walk **west**. Everything is on the surface, so to get back you just walk back to Venore. The {npc:Demon Mother} is on the surface, **southwest** of the Desert Dungeon entrance and **west** of {npc:Adrenius}'s temple.
Location of the Demon Mother in the Jakundaf Desert
Say {key:hi}, {key:challenge} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Demon Infant}, bound to you (you cannot trade it for another baby).
Each fulfilled request makes the baby sleep for 20 hours. After that, wake it up and listen to the next request. You need **6 requests** fulfilled.

**Use** the {item:Demon Infant} to get its attention: it cries and says what it wants (an item, a creature or a place). After 15 seconds it cries again; use it again if you want to hear the request once more.

With the baby's attention, use it on the requested creature, item or place (or use the requested item on it). Look up its phrase in the table below to know what to do. If it works, the success phrase appears and the baby falls asleep for 20 hours.
Give it {item:Dragon Ham} (use the food on the baby) until it is satisfied.
Use the baby on a flying {creature:Firefly (Yellow)}; there are many near bushes and trees in Ab'Dendriel and Tiquanda.
Give it {item:Worm|Worms} until it is satisfied (you can buy them from Equipment Shopkeepers or they drop as loot from {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}).
Use the baby on a live {creature:Black Sheep} (a summoned one works too).
Give it {item:Mouldy Cheese} until it is satisfied (loot from {creature:Goblin|Goblins} and {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}).
Use a {item:Fishing Rod} on the baby several times until its stomach is empty (things like Broken Swords, Dirty Fur, Torn Books, Skulls and Worn Leather Boots come out).
Use your baby on another player's Demon Infant (it can be from a distance, even in the depot).
Use the baby on a live {creature:Dragon} or {creature:Dragon Hatchling}, from a safe distance.
Use the baby on a {creature:Fire Devil} (a summoned one works too).
Stand right next to a bubbling {wiki:Lava} tile (no border or gap between you and the lava) and use the baby. E.g. the Fibula Tunnel bridge or parts of Kazordoon.
Use a {item:Hammer} or {item:Wooden Hammer} on the baby.
Go up onto the deck of the big ship in Venore and use the baby there.

Travel to {wiki:Draconia} and use the baby anywhere on the island. Warning: Draconia can only be reached through a one-way tunnel that starts in the {wiki:Shadow Caves} of Ab'Dendriel (via Hellgate and {wiki:Redbone Castle}) and has no boat back: you get out with a {item:Dragonfetish} (teleport to Ab'Dendriel) or on foot via the Hellgate exit route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}, you need a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} or 6 Parcels).
Use the baby on {npc:Emperor Kruzak} in Kazordoon.

Go to Santa's house in {wiki:Vega} and use the baby near the entrance. Way there: {npc:Nielson}'s raft, northwest of Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:vega}, {key:yes}, 20 gp); the house is **west** of where you land. Way back: {npc:Carlson}'s raft, in the east of Vega ({key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}, free).
Use the baby on a {item:Cask|beer barrel}; there is one in the {wiki:Adventurers' Guild} (you get there by using an Adventurer's Stone in the temple of any city; ask the temple NPC for it).
Use the baby on a {item:War Drum}.
Stand on a sand tile and use the baby.
Give it {item:Wheat} from a {wiki:Wheat Field} until it is satisfied. The wheat has to be ripe, ready to harvest.
Stand on a snow tile (e.g. {wiki:Ice Islands} or near the Feyrist shrine) and use the baby.
Some requests make you go to dangerous areas or get close to hostile creatures (Dragons, Fire Devils...). Use the baby from a distance whenever possible.
Once the 20 hours of sleep are over, use the baby to wake it up and use it again to hear the next request. Repeat until you have **6 requests** fulfilled.

If you leave the baby unattended for too long, it goes back to the Demon Mother on its own and you fail the event with this character. If you lose the baby, you can only continue that year by getting another baby on another character.
After the 6th request is fulfilled, use the {item:Demon Infant} one more time to make it happy (pleased).
Handing it over to the Demon Mother
Go back to the {npc:Demon Mother} and say {key:hi}, {key:baby} and {key:yes}. She gives you a random doll of one of her children.
Random doll (Evilina, Impward, Meandi, Whinona, Badbara, Cryana or Tearesa) + Baby Sitter achievement (and I Did My Part, if you don't have it yet)

If your world returns at least **500 babies** by 14 May, everyone gets **+50% experience until 21 May** and the message *"Your world has pleased the demon mother. Your experience gain is increased!"* appears when you log in. If fewer than 500 are returned, *"The demon mother is disappointed. You were not able to help her with all of her babies."* appears.
Completing the event in 5 different years earns you the **Nanny from Hell** achievement.
Until 2019 the bonus was only 10% experience plus a 50% reduction of the death penalty; that year the dolls Badbara, Tearesa and Cryana were also added.
